author: Overfill
body:
Hello all,

my name is SuperBlahGirl and I was banned for combat logging on CTH. Using the kit enderman, it was VERY glitchy... Because of it glitching into walls and all but I tried to get away from an opponent, so I enderpearled away into a different team's spawn. (not intentionally) And I glitched. I couldn't move or do anything, and I ran out of enderpearls. So, I was stuck in a position where I couldn't do anything at all, except if I did /leave. And that is exactly what I did. Right away, I got banned for 10 days is what I remembered. by _Poseidon_. I hope you understand it Wasn't on purpose either, compared to some of my other infractions. I am completely stunned on how the moderator did not see... Avicus is probably my favourite server too, I really enjoy playing, I've aways had fun... But this was just not the best call :/ I hope you understand.Thank you for your time.

-SuperBlahGirl

title: SuperBlahGirl Ban Appeal

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
First of all, i did record you combat logging and its quite clear. Secondly, although that story would make sense for that moment when you did /leave i had been spectating you for more than 6 minutes by then and you were frequently combat logging. Even before you joined the CTH, in the DTM you were combat logging. Even when you joined CTH you were still combat logging even when you didn't have the enderman kit. Another mod was with me and she saw everything. The console was reporting you like crazy and considering your previous infractions for combat logging i bumped it up to 9 days.

Video: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=upyDgu_7llU

Hello,

The evidence speaks for its self. You will not be appealed. If you Combat Log again, it may well be a permanent ban.  

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
